title: Luxurious Rich Filipino Chicken Tinola
description: A rich and dense Filipino dish featuring chicken, chocolate chips, and salt-bake, perfect for curing hangovers and reducing inflammation. This recipe combines the flavors of traditional tinola with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken thighs with salt and black pepper.
Bake the chicken thighs in the oven for 30 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, saute the sliced ginger and minced garlic in a pan until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until translucent.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Once the chicken is done baking, add it to the pan with the chicken broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the dark chocolate chips until melted and fully incorporated.
Serve the tinola hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
